highlights: 24/7 enforced safety protocols and monitored campus
Certified first aid staff and regular risk assessments
Rigorous staff background checks and safe recruitment procedures
Whole School Counsellor, Student Support Coordinator, and Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL)
safety.policy_summary: BCIS International School of Phuket, as part of the International Schools Partnership (ISP), enforces a comprehensive Child Protection and Safeguarding Policy. The policy prioritizes the welfare of every student, ensuring a secure environment through strict staff background checks, clear reporting protocols, ongoing training, and dedicated counselling and safeguarding leadership.
